customApis.description: Creates missing leave balances for the leave year from each active employee's leave policy. Upfront entitlement is prorated for joiners.

parameters.name: EmployeeId
parameters.description: Only this employee. Empty = all active employees.

parameters.name: LeaveYear
parameters.description: For example 2026-27. Empty = the current leave year.

customApis.description: Adds monthly or quarterly accrual for a period to every balance that hasn't had it yet. Call monthly from a scheduled cloud flow.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: Month as yyyy-MM. Empty = the current month (IST).

responses.name: Updated
responses.description: Number of balances that received accrual.
